AI generators often struggle with the repetitive yet varied nature of organ pipes, leading to slight warping or inconsistent spacing. Verify if the wooden textures show natural grain or if they appear smeared/painted. Check if the perspective lines of the architectural arches align correctly with the organ's placement.
